headline: Six Flags Mandates Roller Coaster Seatbelts Following Fatal Incident
summary: Six Flags announced safety reviews across all its theme park attractions and plans to install seatbelts on roller coasters as the operator confronts legal actions linked to rider safety.
why: Six Flags is one of North America's largest regional amusement park chains, whose financial results rely heavily on guest admissions and safety compliance.

impacts.name: Six Flags Entertainment
impacts.why: Safety retrofits and pending lawsuits increase operational expenses and risk depressing seasonal park attendance.
